units: world glTF metres: +X right, +Z toward the game camera, Y up (Lv1: Tier_* hidden)
method: triangles sampled at <= 0.1 m, a 0.2 m cell blocks when any sample lies in the crew body band y 0.35..2 m (lower = steps/slabs/roads you walk on, higher = overhead: bridge deck, jibs, pipe racks) or when the cell only has geometry below -0.35 m (pit). Closing 3x3 + hole fill (thin walls / enclosures -> solid), objects < 0.6 m apart grouped, groups split until each oriented box is >= 70% filled; every box/hull padded by 0.3 m. Vehicles (HT-04, FB-05), crew (Receiver, operator), moving crane hooks/hoists and the bridge boxes are NOT colliders.
box_convention: box = oriented rectangle: centre (cx, cz), half-extents hx (local X) / hz (local Z) INCLUDING the 0.3 m pad, yaw_deg = three.js rotation.y (local +X -> world (cos yaw, -sin yaw)), y_min..y_max = geometry height range over the footprint
hull_convention: hull (optional, use instead of the box when present) = convex polygon [x, z] world, padding included; given for round tanks/columns where the box is a poor fit
walkable_rule: a point is walkable unless inside a collider (hull if present, else box) - EXCEPT inside any walk_gaps rectangle (same box convention, no extra pad), which is always walkable
